[2026-08-31T03:01:49.068Z] [world] You hear a kettle whistling before you see them. Skiv, fence, has made camp here.
[2026-08-31T03:01:49.068Z] [arbiter] The Arbiter inclines their head toward the newcomer. "Skiv, fence. A figure under a hood, leaned against a half-broken cart. Doesn't make eye contact. The merchandise is suspiciously cheap. The hand under the cloak doesn't move."
[2026-08-31T03:01:49.072Z] [world] Rare workings for sale: Lich-Heart Pendant (200 TC), Many-Colored Tonic (200 TC), Mire Stave (200 TC) — buy one by name to learn it. This one also mends worn gear, trains a stat for coin, and patches up a hurt dog or golem — just ask.
[2026-08-31T03:01:49.078Z] [world] The Core in your pack has changed the hum — harmonized it, one true chord where the old ache used to be. At the outpost an old woman stops you with a hand on your sleeve. "You hear it too," she says. Not a question. Hers is faint, she says, always was; she weeps, without ceremony, when your pack passes her. "Louder," she calls after you. "It likes you better."
[2026-08-31T03:01:49.078Z] [arbiter] The Arbiter is quiet for a stretch, then: "One Core. Most who say they are going after them stop before the first. I have adjusted what I expect of you. Do not make me adjust it back."
